mapper.select: select id, name, category, stock, unit, location, warn_threshold as warnThreshold, status, tag_type as tagType, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from consumable_inventory order by case tag_type when 'danger' then 1 when 'warning' then 2 else 3 end, id desc

select id, name, category, stock, unit, location, warn_threshold as warnThreshold, status, tag_type as tagType, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from consumable_inventory where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into consumable_inventory ( name, category, stock, unit, location, warn_threshold, status, tag_type ) values ( #{name}, #{category}, coalesce(#{stock}, 0), coalesce(nullif(#{unit}, ''), '件'), #{location}, coalesce(#{warnThreshold}, 10), #{status}, #{tagType} )
mapper.update: update consumable_inventory set name = #{consumable.name}, category = #{consumable.category}, stock = coalesce(#{consumable.stock}, stock), unit = coalesce(nullif(#{consumable.unit}, ''), unit), location = #{consumable.location}, warn_threshold = coalesce(#{consumable.warnThreshold}, warn_threshold), status = #{consumable.status}, tag_type = #{consumable.tagType}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
